  • Method Details

    • GetTaskForId

      public static Task GetTaskForId(int taskId) throws Exception
      Gets a Task from the database that matches the given id
      Parameters:
      taskId - The taskId you of the Task you want to retrieve
      Returns:
      A Task objecting containing the given taskId's information of the taskId, name, description and labourId(QuestId) or Null if that taskID doesn't exist
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the given taskId is equal to 0
      Exception - If there is a Database Access Failure OR user doesn't have separate tasks

    • GetTasksForLabourId

      public static List<Task> GetTasksForLabourId(int labourId) throws Exception
      Gets every storyline quest task that belongs to a labour. Weekly practices are stored separately and are not returned here.
      Parameters:
      labourId - The labourId you want the quest tasks for
      Returns:
      A list of Task objects, empty if none exist
      Throws:
      Exception - If the labourId is invalid or a Database Access Failure occurs

    • GetRandomAmountOfTaskIdsForLabourId

      public static int[] GetRandomAmountOfTaskIdsForLabourId(int labourId) throws Exception
      Gets random weekly-practice task ids for a labour. These come from the weekly pool, not the storyline quest tasks.
      Parameters:
      labourId - The labourId that you will get weekly taskId's for
      Returns:
      A populated Array of weekly taskId's that have a matching labourId to the one given
      Throws:
      Exception - If the labourId is null OR a Database Access Failure

    • GetTaskIdsForLabourWeek

      public static int[] GetTaskIdsForLabourWeek(int labourId, int weekNumber) throws Exception
      Gets the three weekly-practice ids for a labour week. Week 1 is the first three weekly tasks, week 2 the next three, and so on. Storyline quest tasks are never included.
      Parameters:
      labourId - The labour whose weekly pool to read
      weekNumber - The 1-based week of the labour
      Returns:
      Weekly task ids for that week, empty if none exist
      Throws:
      Exception
